Here’s a more professional and heartfelt rewrite of your email:  

---

**Subject:** Thank You & Next Steps  

Hi Melanie,  

Thank you so much for your time today. We truly appreciate the opportunity to connect and are excited about the possibility of partnering with you and your sister to support the growth of your businesses. I’ve attached the growth plan for your review.  

If you have any questions or would like clarity on any part of the plan, I’d be more than happy to hop on a quick call before our meeting on Tuesday. Additionally, if you can share some further metrics from both locations, I can incorporate that into a comprehensive offer for you.  

Please know that I’m keeping your family in my prayers during this very difficult time. I hope the rest of your week brings you moments of peace and encouragement.  

Looking forward to connecting again next week.  

With gratitude,  
[Your Name]  

---  

Would you like me to also make a **slightly warmer, softer version** (a little less formal, but still professional) so you can choose between the two depending on her personality and the tone you want to set?
